messages.subject: Re: Milkweed seeds
messages.text:
Hi Veronica,

Sorry for the long delay in getting you a real answer, this one slipped past us far too long and that's on us.

Our milkweed seeds are sourced from commercial milkweed farms in eastern Canada. Farm-grown seeds are harvested at the right time, properly dried and stored, which makes them more reliable than hand-picked wild seeds. We sell several species, Common (Syriaca), Butterfly (Tuberosa), Swamp (Incarnata), and a few others, all available at lasclay.com/en/products/milkweed-seeds.

Happy to answer anything else about them.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
